title: Stuck in the same dev.to topics? An open model fixed it.
why_read: A simple personal project building a dev.to digest emailer using an open-weight model for summaries, useful as an example but limited in depth.
analysis: This describes a small open-source script that curates a personalized weekly digest from a user's dev.to feed using an open-weight language model to generate one-sentence summaries. It's a lightweight, practical use of LLMs for content curation with no server or account needed, which is a nice minimal design choice. Technical depth is limited since it's largely glue code around an existing model, but it's a clean, well-scoped personal project.
